question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 9.**
solution:
The correct answer is "**people**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of given words.
 
• **human(singular)**: being, relating to, or belonging to a person or to people as opposed to animals
 
• **individual(singular)**: a single human being as distinct from a group.
 
• **people(plural**):human beings in general or considered collectively.
 
• **person(singular): **a human being regarded as an individual.
 
• The given statement talks about 7 million people so we need to use **people**.

**Hence, the correct answer is option 3**

**The complete passage is-** *The air has become very dirty in **(1) many** parts of the world. This is of course **(2) harmful** to your health. Experts say many people die** (3) from** it each year. There is a new study on **(4) air** pollution which comes from the experts of the World Health Organization (WHO) **(5) which** is an agency of the United Nations. If you **(6) inhale** unhealthy air for long periods of time, you could **(7) become** sick. Air pollution has been linked to many diseases **(8) like** stroke and cancer. The WHO says that seven million **(9) people** die each year as a result of the **(10) polluted** air.*
